free_tier.stated: a metered quota on the Copilot plan, with compute at $0.000024 a second, memory at $0.000003 a GiB-second and snapshot storage at $0.005 a GiB-month once it is exhausted; an account with no payment method is blocked at the quota

limits.value: compute at $0.000024 a second and memory at $0.000003 a GiB-second once the included quota is spent
snapshot storage for stopped sessions is $0.005 a GiB-month
without a payment method, usage is blocked at the quota rather than billed past it

identity_cost.detail: A GitHub personal account with a verified email address, and a card only past the plan's included compute usage. GitHub's account page: 'To get started with GitHub.com, you need to have a personal account and a verified email address.' The billing page puts the payment method after the quota: 'If your account does not have a valid payment method on file, usage is blocked once you use up your quota.' Country limit, quoted: 'These destinations currently include Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Belarus, and the following regions of Ukraine: Crimea/Sevastopol and the separatist areas of Donetsk and Luhansk.', where Copilot 'may not be sold, exported, or re-exported to any embargoed destination' or a Country Group E:1 destination.
